corpus.jsonl:
def gen(N, rng):
    lines=[]
    evs=['click','view','purchase','scroll']
    while sum(len(l) for l in lines)<N+200:
        i=len(lines)
        lines.append('{"event":"%s","user_id":%d,"session":"%08x","ts":%d,"props":{"page":"/p/%d","ref":"%s"}}'%(rng.choice(evs),10000+rng.randrange(5000),rng.getrandbits(32),1700000000+i,rng.randrange(300),rng.choice(['google','direct','email'])))
    return '\n'.join(lines).encode()[:N]
